Hareta vs. Koya | numeps1=7 | numeps2=15 | location=Outskirts of [[Floaroma Town]] | firststagename=Shinx | secondstagename=Luxio | prevonum=403 | evo1num=404 | evo2num=405 | current=[[Party|With Hareta]]| va=no | }} '''Hareta's Luxray''' (Japanese: '''ハレタのレントラー''' ''Hareta's Rentorar'') is the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} {{pkmn2|caught}} by [[Hareta]] in [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]], and his second overall. ==History== [[File:Hareta Shinx.png|thumb|150px|left|As a Shinx]] {{p|Luxray}} first appeared as a {{p|Shinx}} in ''[[DPA03|The Mystery Boy, Jun!!]]''. When {{OBP|Jun|DPA}} challenged Hareta to a [[Pokémon battle]], he retracted his offer when he discovered that Hareta's only Pokémon was {{TP|Hareta|Piplup}}. After having the concept of catching [[wild Pokémon]] explained, Hareta went to the nearest forest and eventually caught a Shinx with the hopes that Jun would now battle him. However, said battle never actually occurred due to [[Team Galactic]]'s interference at the [[Valley Windworks]]. During the fight against [[Mars]] Shinx was called out to use Spark on her {{p|Zubat}}, with the added bonus of providing light for Hareta and Jun. Immediately after the attack Shinx ran over to the broken electrical grid and shot electricity into it to turn the lights back on. Having full access to light Hareta and Piplup quickly defeat {{TP|Mars|Purugly}}. In ''[[DPA04|Win with Teamwork!!]]'', Shinx was used in Hareta's battle against [[Gardenia]] and her {{p|Cherubi}}. Cherubi starts the battle by laying a trap with {{m|Leech Seed}}, leaving it open to a Bite attack, defeating it. Shinx next battled {{p|Turtwig}} and knocked it out with a single Spark. Despite the easy win it quickly became apparent that Shinx was immobilized by Turtwig's {{m|Grass Knot}}. Unable to dodge Shinx was hit by {{p|Roserade}}'s {{m|Magical Leaf}} and knocked out. [[File:Hareta Luxio.png|thumb|150px|left|As a Luxio]] In ''[[DPA10|Serious Training on Iron Island!!]]'', Shinx participated in Hareta's training on [[Iron Island]]. During the training he defeated a wild {{p|Onix}} with his Bite after {{p|Misdreavus}} made it flinch with {{m|Astonish}}. After some intense training [[B-2]] shows up and attacks Shinx with a {{p|Drapion}}. Seeing Shinx hurt inspires Hareta's new {{p|Riolu}} into action, giving it the motivation to defeat it. After the battle Shinx reveals that he was fine the whole time, only pretending to help Riolu out. He then evolves into a {{p|Luxio}}. In ''[[DPA12|A Battle Of Wills]]'', Luxio battled alongside Piplup against [[Saturn]] and her {{p|Rhyperior}} and {{TP|Saturn|Toxicroak}}. Luxio attacks with a Thunder aimed at {{p|Toxicroak}} which gets redirected to Rhyperior due to its {{a|Lightning Rod}} Ability. Rhyperior and Toxicroak proceed to make quick work of their opponents, knocking them and their Trainer out. He [[DPA13|later]] participated in the battle against [[Cyrus]], where he launched Thunder at his {{p|Gyarados}}. Just as the attack is about to hit Saturn's Rhyperior returns and uses Lightning Rod again, nullifying the attack. [[File:Hareta Luxio Intimidate.png|thumb|150px|Intimidate activated, as a Luxio]] In ''[[DPA14|A Novel Test!!]]'', Luxio was used in a double battle alongside Riolu against [[Candice]]'s {{p|Regirock}} and {{p|Regice}}. The battle starts with Luxio using his ability {{a|Intimidate}} to slow them down, but their {{a|Clear Body}} keeps them going strong. Regirock strikes with {{m|Hammer Arm}}, which Riolu blocks. Riolu is then frozen by Regice's {{m|Ice Beam}} and Luxio is defeated from Regirock's {{m|Dig}}. Soon after Riolu [[Evolution|evolves]] into {{p|Lucario}} and wins the battle for Hareta. Luxio fought against [[Mitsumi]] in ''[[DPA17|Clash! Hareta vs. Mitsumi!!]]'' when she rejoined [[Team Galactic]]. He attempted to use Thunder but {{TP|Mitsumi|Infernape}} emerged from underground and quickly defeats Luxio. In ''[[DPA25|Clash! Hareta vs. Koya]]'', Luxio was used in Hareta's second match in the [[Pokémon League]]. He fought against a Trainer's {{p|Heracross}}, getting beat up trying to win. Determined to win Luxio gets back up and defeats it with a high powered Thunder. In the semi final battle he fought against [[Koya]]'s {{p|Absol}}. Before getting an attack out Absol swiftly closes the distance and uses {{m|Sucker Punch}}. After that Luxio was struck with {{m|Iron Tail}}, sending him flying. Hareta jumped into action and caught him. After a few moments on the ground Luxio evolves into Luxray, ready to keep going. Hareta reveals that he knew Luxray was ready to evolve and he was giving it the chance to do so. Koya switches in for {{p|Metagross}} who gets hit by Thunder Fang. The victory is short lived as Metagross counters with {{m|Earthquake}}. Unable to go on Hareta switches him in for {{TP|Hareta|Regigigas}}. In ''[[DPA36|Hareta's Fierce Battle!]]'', Luxray is sent out to help battle against {{p|Giratina}}, though he does not last long. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Hareta and Luxray.png|thumb|220px|Luxray and Hareta]] Luxray is a proud and friendly Pokémon who is dedicated to help his friends. He has a high level of inner strength, refusing to give up when committed to a goal. He cares greatly for others and will jump straight into danger without a second thought in order to save someone. ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|Electric||Hareta {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Shinx Spark|1=Shinx Bite|2=Luxio Thunder|3=Luxio Bite}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Spark as a Shinx|1=Bite as a Shinx|2=Thunder as a Luxio|3=Bite as a Luxio}}|image2=Hareta {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Luxio Charge|1=Luxray Thunder Fang|2=Luxray Discharge}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Charge as a Luxio|1=Thunder Fang|2=Discharge}}}} {{anmov|Electric|Spark|DPA03|The Mystery Boy, Jun!!}} {{anmov|Dark|Bite|DPA04|Win with Teamwork!!}} {{anmov|Electric|Thunder|DPA12|A Battle Of Wills}} {{anmov|Electric|Charge|DPA25|Clash!
